name: @hdsp/connector-manager-ui
description: ZoeConnect Connector Manager -- local web UI (Task #103, 2026-07-22). A Vite/React SPA, built as static assets and served by the Connector Windows Service's own local REST API server (see connector/src/api/local-api-server.ts). This package produces ONLY the static build output (dist/) -- it has no server of its own and is never run standalone against a real backend other than the Connector's local API on 127.0.0.1.
